body:
You’ll have to click over to Vimeo, but it will be worth it. (Thanks, Mary and Mandy!)

 And for more inspiring music, check this out from Middle Church in NYC –

 A beautiful virtual hymn from our gospel choir to start your morning. We might be physically separated from one another, but our hearts and voices remain united.

 Let's use them to raise a song of love and justice in this moment ❤️ pic.twitter.com/BZePaRArOW

 — Middle Church (@middlechurch) March 31, 2020
